# Wave020 A — useful automation without established heldout gain

Independent FIRST,15October2026; peer020 unread, no helpers or new experiments. Source/code inspection only; no data/model/Y/native/fit/largehash/project writes. Zero novelty: one refinement of HYP-002/046 and prior rounds026/029/033/042, with wave018 diagnosis boundaries retained. This optional note adds no task, gate, grant or delay to015/018.

Root-provided development context: tuned manual B41=.458611NDCG after4fits/12looks; W=B+3R2=.464703. Selection has4000Q,73positiveQ/96fullY targets/65retrieved; descriptive ΔCI crosses0. Final25–31 remains CLOSED. These numbers do not establish practical improvement. If the later heldout decision predicate fails, report that outcome; do not retrofit another feature or claim equivalence from uncertainty.

**mechanism.** The most useful surviving deliverable is the existing executable chain from human-reviewed schema roles/templates through generated definitions, semantic aliases, physical closure and explicit model-input projection. A single primitive definition determines its calculation and companions: recency brings its missing mask; two nominal cores can therefore consume three physical columns. Name changes do not turn a semantic alias into new information. Generated signatures and exact ordered projections expose definition drift before paid source/model work.

This replaces repeated manual transcription with a reproducible declared program, but human work remains in semantics, templates, bindings, validation and review. Current generation is bounded by hard-coded reviewed families/windows; arbitrary schema renaming or a novel operation is not supported automatically. Eight generated bundles are not eight independently discovered useful families. Code/site counts do not measure hours saved.

**prediction.** For the same small metadata faults, the existing typed generator/closure/projection path should reject aliases, omitted mandatory companions and wrong physical-to-model bindings at least as reliably as unchanged005 plus an independent manual checklist, without requiring new source/model execution. A validated recurrence is an engineering reliability result; labour savings and speed remain unmeasured.

**nearest source-free test, not executed here.** Reuse public manual18/automation-pool definitions and the already archived typed/mask/projection regression cases. One bounded pack,≤16 variants/256KiB metadata, labels only “valid/rejected” from independently written literal expectations: unchanged legal definition; renamed alias; retrieval-equivalent purchase-users168h; cart recency with missing mask omitted; combined48 schema incorrectly treated as base-first45; explicit base-name projection plus chosen3. Preserve AST/source-policy annotations and exact feature order. Compare the existing automatic checks with the strong simple control:005 registry validation plus a flat independently authored alias/closure/order checklist on identical inputs. Do not disable validation or compare against unchecked handwritten SQL. No helper producing actual output also supplies the expected list.

**task1benefit.** The final report can present inspectable generated programs, scope-correct source/calculation evidence, complete attempts/costs and an honest negative or uncertain predictive contrast. Demonstrated static fault rejection would support reduced specification drift within this vocabulary. It would not substitute for mandatory015/018, independently prove every old B41 formula, or transform an unsuccessful ranking hypothesis into a successful one.

**strongest counterexample/cost.** AST and emitted schema can agree perfectly while a shared resolver uses the wrong global peer bucket or candidate-only category denominator. A static pass cannot detect that common-mode numerical error; existing independent source oracles retain their scope. Likewise, an equally effective checklist may cost less than maintaining a generator. Proposed optional metadata-test ceiling30CPU/60wall seconds/128MiB,0data/SQL/native/models/Y/fits,all parsing/mutants/rejections/reporting paid; no execution grant. Actual source preparation and failed model attempts remain in the historical cost ledger, not credited as free automation.

**negative decision.** If automatic checks miss a fault or add no value over the checklist, retain only reproducible generation evidence and keep the simpler control. Without human-time measurements say “removed repeated transcription”, not quantified labour savings. No added benchmark, framework or mandatory backlog item follows.

# Wave020 — value if final gain is zero or negative

Independent FIRST, 15 October 2026. **Zero new mechanisms/IDs.** This is a claim refinement of existing016 typed generation,018 source reproduction, HYP046 execution planning, and rounds029–030. Peer020 was not read. Mandatory015/018 remain the priority; this note creates no gate or execution grant.

**Defensible claim.** A human-bounded typed generator can turn declared schema roles, windows and templates into concrete feature programs, reject specified illegal/exact-alias programs, account for physical companions, and execute a finite experimental allocation whose result may be negative. This is a useful engineering contribution and a bounded empirical result. It does not establish useful feature discovery, arbitrary-schema understanding, generalization gain, human-time savings or a causal advantage over manual design. Round029 already states this distinction; repackaging it is not a new hypothesis.

**Mechanism.** The existing path is role binding → typed instantiation → legality/semantic dedup → emitted physical closure → frozen four-slot allocation → inherited strong learner. Eight bundles arise from human-authored rules; they are not eight stored output registries. Core definitions, missingness fields and physical ordering are separate objects. A sound construction claim requires witnesses connecting each transformation; hashes alone cannot certify a formula. Accepted historical output verification applies to its recovered source. The new one-day source-to-fixed-model path is underway; no result or fresh source reproducibility is assumed.

**Prediction.** An evidence audit should support exact, scoped statements about generated definitions, physical closure and the original allocation while rejecting broader quality/speed/labour claims. The construction-only walkthrough's zero fits must not erase the historical four fits. Independent scalar fixtures support their enumerated cases, not semantic completeness or production portability.

**Nearest single bounded test, proposed only.** Predeclare twelve claim rows, including generation versus stored enumeration, legality rejection, alias equality, value/mask closure, B41 preservation, fixed allocation, collisions/no-refill, fit/look counts, original source scope, metric population, selected uncertainty and fresh-source status. Trace them using at most twenty already-existing small code/docs/JSON witnesses, eight bundle definitions and four slot records. Mark each “supported within stated scope”, “contradicted”, or “not checked”; missing receipts do not become passes. First mismatched definition/closure or unsupported claim is the cheapest falsifier. This audit reads no source rows, score arrays, models or Y and produces no new quality feedback.

**Matched countercontrol.** Use the same declared roles/windows/operators and hand-instantiated reference definitions with the accepted005 typed registry as the information-equivalent construction control. Compare the same core/physical fields and rejection reasons already represented in independent witnesses. A generator merely reproducing that control can demonstrate deterministic automation; it cannot demonstrate smarter search. No comparison against naive repeated scans or a weakened learner is admissible. A missing independent witness leaves that row unverified rather than commissioning a new oracle.

**Task1 benefit and negative outcome.** The report can explain a reproducible method and its measured limitations. Existing development evidence is B=.458610728441 versus selected R2=.464702877384, with73 positive queries/96 fullY pairs and65 retrieved pairs among4000 queries; the descriptive post-selection interval crosses zero. A random slot won, so rule-guided superiority is unsupported. Final zero/negative gain would mean this frozen procedure did not demonstrate improvement on its specified population; it would not prove equivalence, universal uselessness, or compensate for an invalid calculation. Final25–31 remains closed. B's four fits/twelve prefix looks and016's four fits/four looks are different historical searches, not a matched manual-versus-automation strategy trial.

**Total cost.** Proposed audit: ≤2MiB metadata,20 files,12 claims,8 bundles,4 slots; ≤60CPU/120wall seconds,128MiB,0 fits/predictions/metric looks/source scans. Include failed reads, construction and reviewer checks inside that cap; stop with “not checked” on exhaustion. Historical016 source+four fits+observer+admission upper is1704.75CPU seconds, not the generator's isolated cost. Manual tuning and the separate current018 operation retain their own ledgers; no free preparation, new budget or speedup is inferred.
